prompt: Create a dramatic ultra-realistic anime cosplay portrait of Arthur Pencilgon as a tall athletic female fantasy warrior in a desolate rocky battlefield. She is lunging aggressively toward the camera in a low forward stance, intense blue eyes locked on the viewer, holding a long golden spear directly toward the lens so the spearhead dominates the lower-left foreground with strong depth-of-field blur. Give her extremely long flowing deep purple hair tied high in a ponytail, wind-swept across the left side of the frame, with sharp anime-inspired facial features rendered in photoreal detail. Her outfit is glossy dark burgundy leather and armor with gold trim: a white armored chest plate, triangular engraved gold collar ornament, burgundy high-neck bodice, shoulder and arm bands, black fingerless glove on the spear hand, cutout waist armor, strapped thigh guards, knee-high shin armor, and open-toe gladiator sandals. Use a cinematic fantasy wasteland background with jagged stone pillars, scattered rocks, dusty ground, haze, and a stormy gray sky. Camera angle is dynamic and slightly low, portrait orientation, centered character, wide-angle perspective exaggerating the spear and action pose. Lighting should be moody and high-contrast with soft rim light on hair and armor, realistic skin texture, shiny reflective armor, dust atmosphere, shallow depth of field, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影级超写实动漫 Cosplay 肖像，主角为 Arthur Pencilgon，她是一位身材高挑健美的女性奇幻战士，身处荒凉的岩石战场。她正以低姿势向前突刺，气势汹汹地冲向镜头，深邃的蓝色双眼紧盯着观众，手中紧握的长矛直指镜头，矛头占据左下角前景，并带有强烈的景深模糊效果。她留着极长的 深紫色 飘逸长发，扎成高马尾，随风飘向画面左侧，面部特征具有鲜明的动漫风格，并以超写实细节呈现。她的服装由光泽感的深酒红色皮革和带有金色饰边的盔甲组成：白色胸甲、三角形雕花金色领饰、酒红色高领紧身衣、肩带和臂带、持矛手佩戴黑色露指手套、镂空腰甲、绑带大腿护甲、及膝护胫以及露趾角斗士凉鞋。背景采用电影感奇幻荒原，包含参差不齐的石柱、散落的岩石、尘土飞扬的地面、薄雾和阴沉的灰色天空。摄像机角度动态且略微偏低，采用竖屏构图，角色居中，广角透视夸大了长矛和动作姿态。光影效果应具有情绪感和高对比度，头发和盔甲边缘带有柔和的轮廓光，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、闪亮的反射盔甲、尘埃氛围、浅景深，无文字，无水印。
